description:
Hushfeed v0.16.0 targets global TikTok 46.2.3 (com.zhiliaoapp.musically).

Every settings page now shares AMOLED backgrounds, grouped rows and larger headings. Feature Gate Lab, gate details and recording reports follow the same layout. Light mode and larger English/German text remain supported. Native preferences keep their existing actions and saved values.

Validation: 156 runtime tests passed locally. The release bundle contains 61 patches and passed checks for all three DEX payloads. Offscreen Android rendering covered both themes; phone installation has not been verified.

The downloadable .mpp is the patch bundle. Patch on the device with Morphe Manager and keep its existing signing key.
